headline: Designer, creative director and content producer who pairs operational discipline with a strong visual and cultural instinct.

roles.title: Principal / Lead Creative
points: Run a creative studio delivering brand strategy, content production and creative direction, managing the full cycle from concept through editing and delivery with freelance editors and designers.
Create and distribute short-form video and social content, building a platform of 30,000+ followers and 6.5M+ views across Reels, TikTok and YouTube.
Art-direct cover art and visual identity for my own releases and other artists.
Direct and edit campaign video for NYC-DSA candidates, including a walking-interview piece for Aber Kawas (2026).

roles.title: Product & Data Analyst
points: Designed AI-powered workflows and prototypes, integrating emerging AI tools into content and product processes.
Wrote the product brief and UX direction for results, rankings and student profiles on a K–12 academic competition platform.

roles.title: Project Manager
points: Owned client engagements end to end (scopes, timelines, deliverables) as the primary point of contact, coordinating cross-functional teams from kickoff through delivery.

roles.title: Business Analyst
points: Managed cross-functional product launches across R&D, Sales and Logistics, owning roadmaps, timelines, budgets and stakeholder communication.
Led the shift from waterfall to agile and built the process documentation that let the work repeat.

roles.title: Business Development & Creative Strategy Fellow
points: Designed fundraising campaigns and creative strategy for nonprofit clients, supporting campaigns that raised up to $250K and building influencer partnerships to expand reach.
